comparison.objective: Place two ballast blocks so the combined payload-deck center of mass lies over a center mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Mass-based reasoning, planar block placement, and balance control.
comparison.success_condition: Both blocks lie flat and combined center of mass is within 5 mm horizontally of the mark, using stated 300 g, 120 g, and 60 g masses.
comparison.reason: Static mass balancing has no impact fracture, narrow-tool alignment, protected hardware, or released-fragment recovery.
